faq_heading: Homes near Old Yale Road Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Old Yale Road Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Old Yale Road Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It matches the school’s name in the listing text. A home near Old Yale Road Elementary whose listing doesn’t mention it won’t appear.

faq.q: How much do homes near Old Yale Road Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 234 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,100,000, townhomes $575,000, condos $395,900. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Old Yale Road Elementary?
faq.a: For the 234 homes that sold within 1 km of Old Yale Road Elementary, the median time on the market was 34 days and the median sale was 96.5% of list; 10% sold above list.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Old Yale Road Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Kwantlen Park Secondary (0.6 km north), A H P Matthew Elementary (0.9 km south) and K B Woodward Elementary (0.9 km north).

Old Yale Road Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 10135 132 St. It teaches grades K to 7.
Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions Old Yale Road Elementary, followed by what homes within 1 km of the school sold for.
How the Old Yale Road Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Old Yale Road Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Old Yale Road Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 234 homes sold within 1 km of Old Yale Road Elementary: 36 houses, 5 townhomes and 187 condos. The largest group was condos, at a median of $395,900.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Old Yale Road Elementary

32 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Old Yale Road Elementary in a straight line (20 elementary, 11 secondary, 1 other; 4 independent). The closest is Kwantlen Park Secondary, 0.6 km away, and the farthest on this list is SAIL Secondary, 2.6 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is A H P Matthew Elementary (0.9 km); the nearest independent school is Honour Secondary School (1.2 km). Other elementary schools close by: A H P Matthew Elementary (0.9 km south), K B Woodward Elementary (0.9 km north), Theresa Clarke Elementary (1.5 km north), Prince Charles Elementary (1.6 km west), Betty Huff Elementary (1.6 km south). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is A H P Matthew Elementary, 0.9 km south of Old Yale Road Elementary.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median condo within 1 km of Old Yale Road Elementary was $395,900, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
